dataPipeline.grain: one row = one outlet record (point of sale, or one listed contact location) of a camera-shop banner; a co-branded storefront is one row with linked banners
steps: Export every tab of the research master to CSV (00_README … 99_APPROVED_SCOPE)

Resolve each of the 144 venues to a CityMETER production host (reviewed crosswalk: research-sheet link, name, alias, address, sole-in-province); check the host point against the production province polygon and, in Bangkok, record base/locatePoint
Decode the Bangkok Locales that hold a host point from base/mvt/ML (z15) and union their pieces

Pick host footprints: reuse Luxury Brands footprints for shared centres, else the CityMETER V4 building containing the host point (area agrees with building/detail within 12 %, plausibility rule) or an OSM building named like the venue within 150 m; otherwise none
Run scripts/build-camera-data.py (npm run data:build) to write the public data files
Run scripts/extract-provinces.mjs (npm run data:provinces) for the province frames
Run npm test (snapshot fixtures fail when the data changes — update them deliberately)

cohorts.current: default — retail outlet listings (233 rows); identity holds stay in with their status label

selection.segmentQuery: segment=<id> keeps an outlet when any of its banners is in that segment and counts only those banners (projectSegment returns a copy; rows are never mutated)
selection.areaFocusQuery: areas=comma-separated production Locale uuids (≤ 3) or areas=all to disable auto focus
selection.neighborhoodQuery: neighborhood=<production Locale uuid> — the same id as /v3/citymeter/BKK/L/<uuid>
selection.provinceQuery: province=<production code of any of the 77 provinces in js/model.js PROVINCES (base/info/lv0 abbrEn, e.g. BKK, CMI, NST, UTT)>; Thai and English names still resolve
selection.cameraQuery: view3d=0 forces the plan preset; cam=model switches the venue-level camera from eye (default) to model; legacy cam=eye is accepted
selection.panelQuery: store=<outlet id CAM-O-…> opens store mode; place=<CityMETER host id: Shopping Center id or Grocery record id> opens venue mode; neighborhood=<Locale uuid> opens neighborhood mode
selection.legacyMallQuery: mall=<host id> narrows the venue filter to that host's label when present
